Play this game in pairs. Take turns asking and answering questions.
Ask and answer as many questions as you can in five minutes to find
similarities between your and your partner’s likes. For each similar
liking your pair will get one point. Add up your points when the game
is over. The pair having the highest points is the winner. Use the
following clue to play the game:
A: Llike ice cream. And you?
B: I like ice cream too, (One point)
B: 1 like playing chess. And you?
A: I don’t like playing chess. (No points)
Read the dialogue between A and B silently. Underline the words that
express liking/disliking. Then act out the dialogue in pairs,
Hello. How are you doing?
I’m OK. I’ve just finished a course on photography.
Great! Did you like the course?
Yes, I loved the course so much! You know, I like photography a lot. How
about you? What sorts of things do you like?
: I don’t like photography but I like fishing. I went fishing to a nearby
village last week. Did you ever go fishing?
: Errr, [like eating fish. I actually love fish cutlet. But I don’t like to go
fishing. It’s hard to wait for hours looking at the water!
: That’s right. You need to have patience.1 enjoy fishing. It’s really
exciting when you catch a fish after hours of waiting. Would you
like to come with me next time?
B: I’m not sure, But I would love to taste fish cutlet.
: Well. Pll certainly invite you to come to my place enjoy fish
cutlets with me.
: Thank you. Sounds great! Thanks!
